changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[GetPredicateFunctionalTypeValue] ( @ID int ) RETURNS nvarchar(max) AS BEGIN if @ID is not null begin if @ID = 1 begin return 'Simple Data Lineage' end if @ID = 2 begin return 'Evaluation' end if @ID = 3 begin return 'Inter-type Hierarchy' end if @ID = 4 begin return 'Intra-type Hierarchy' end if @ID = 6 begin return 'Grammatic Association' end if @ID = 7 begin return 'Simple' end if @ID = 9 begin return 'See Also' end if @ID = 12 begin return 'Transformation' end if @ID = 13 begin return 'Business To Technical' end if @ID = 14 begin return 'Semantic Relation' end if @ID = 15 begin return 'Diagram' end if @ID = 16 begin return 'Diagram Use' end if @ID = 17 begin return 'Diagram Reference' end end return '' END
